description: Catalog of public datasets the operator can sync to local cache. Each entry describes: pack_id (stable identifier used by source handlers), source URL (bulk download), parser module (core.refdata.packs.<pack_id>), refresh cadence, license, trust class for collapse policy, and a rough size estimate so operators can plan storage. The sync worker iterates this list on schedule; source handlers call refdata.manager.is_fresh(pack_id) to decide local-first vs live-fallback.

datasets.name: OFAC Specially Designated Nationals
datasets.description: US Treasury Office of Foreign Assets Control consolidated SDN list. Every individual, entity, vessel, aircraft designated for sanctions under US programs (SDGT, IRAN, RUSSIA-EO14024, etc.). Updated daily. The DELIMITED form (sdn.csv + alt.csv + add.csv) is the operational format; bulk XML is also published. Parser uses CSV to keep dependencies minimal.
datasets.notes: Replaces the per-call live CSV download in investigate_ofac. After first sync, every investigation hits PG instead of the Treasury server.

datasets.name: UN Consolidated Sanctions List
datasets.description: United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions list. Aggregates designations across UN sanctions regimes (DRC, ISIL/Al-Qaida, Libya, Mali, Yemen, etc.). Published as XML. Catches designations OFAC alone might miss when the target isn't US-relevant.
datasets.notes: Schedule sync after OFAC (same day). The two lists overlap but each has unique designations.

datasets.name: OpenSanctions Default Consolidated Dataset
datasets.description: OpenSanctions aggregates sanctions, PEPs, watchlists, and crime data from 200+ public sources into a single normalized JSON-FtM stream. The 'default' dataset is the consolidated cross-source feed. Free bulk download under CC-BY 4.0; replaces the paid /match API for most uses.
datasets.notes: Large download — operator confirms before first sync. Subsequent syncs are incremental (ETag-based). Replaces the paid API path for most lookups; the paid /match endpoint stays available for PEP-category and topic queries when OPENSANCTIONS_API_KEY is set.

_principles: Adjustable per server: operators opt in to each pack individually. Empty cache means live-only; populated cache means local-first.
Trust class flows downstream: pack's trust_class becomes the dataset_id's collapse policy default when admitted via the gateway.
Refresh cadence is a hint, not a contract — the touch-to-refresh layer can force a sync when a node is opened with a stale pack.
Static datasets (one-time release) get cadence='static' and are never auto-refreshed.
Sensitive corpora (review_required trust) require operator confirmation before first sync.
